tagline: Schedule sprint ceremonies and post Zoom summaries to Linear issues automatically
metaTitle: Linear + Zoom Integration: Sprint Calls and Summaries
metaDescription: Schedule sprint ceremonies from Linear cycles and turn Zoom action items into issues. GAIA posts call summaries. See the setup steps.
intro:
Engineering sprint ceremonies — planning, standup, review, retrospective — happen in Zoom. The action items, decisions, and issue updates from those meetings should live in Linear. But capturing that context from a call and getting it back into the backlog requires someone to take notes, identify action items, and manually create or update issues after every meeting. That process is rarely done consistently.

GAIA automates the connection between the two by scheduling ceremonies automatically from cycle dates, transcribing and summarizing meetings, and extracting action items as new issues. The team gets a meeting record attached to the right sprint without anyone spending time on post-meeting admin.

This integration is ideal for remote engineering teams that run all their ceremonies over Zoom and want the insights from those meetings captured in Linear automatically rather than lost in meeting notes that nobody reads.

useCases.title: Auto-schedule sprint ceremonies from Linear cycles
useCases.description: When a new cycle is created, GAIA schedules recurring Zoom meetings for sprint planning, daily standup, sprint review, and retrospective based on the cycle dates and the team's configured ceremony cadence.

useCases.title: Post Zoom meeting summaries to cycles
useCases.description: After a sprint ceremony ends, GAIA generates a meeting summary using the transcript and attaches it as a comment on the corresponding cycle so the team has a searchable record of what was discussed.

useCases.title: Create issues from meeting action items
useCases.description: GAIA identifies action items in meeting transcripts — commitments, follow-up tasks, blockers raised — and creates corresponding issues assigned to the relevant team member with the meeting context as the issue description.

useCases.title: Add call recording links to issues
useCases.description: After a call that references specific issues by ID, GAIA attaches the recording link to each mentioned issue so engineers can review the conversation context without asking for the link.

useCases.title: Generate sprint review agenda from the cycle
useCases.description: Before the sprint review meeting, GAIA generates an agenda document listing all completed issues with their titles and descriptions, ready to share as a meeting document so the team can walk through shipped work systematically.

howItWorks.step: Connect Zoom and Linear to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA with your Zoom account and Linear workspace. Configure the ceremony types, their default durations, and the meeting settings GAIA should use when scheduling.

howItWorks.step: Map ceremony types to cycle events
howItWorks.description: Tell GAIA which cycle events should trigger which meeting types and where meeting summaries and action items should be posted in the workspace.

howItWorks.step: Sprint ceremonies schedule and document themselves
howItWorks.description: GAIA creates the meetings when cycles start, joins them to capture transcripts, and posts summaries and action items where you mapped them after each ceremony ends.

faqs.question: Does GAIA join Zoom meetings automatically or only if invited?
faqs.answer: GAIA joins meetings it schedules automatically. For meetings you schedule independently, you can invite GAIA's participant link and it will join, transcribe, and post a summary to your configured destination.

faqs.question: How accurate is GAIA's action item extraction from transcripts?
faqs.answer: GAIA uses structured prompt analysis on the transcripts to identify action items with high confidence. It flags extracted items for human review before creating issues, so you can approve, edit, or discard each one before it enters the backlog.

faqs.question: Can GAIA schedule meetings based on team members' calendar availability?
faqs.answer: Yes. When connected to Google Calendar or Outlook, GAIA checks team member availability before scheduling ceremony times and picks the slot with the best attendance overlap within your configured working hours.
